reason: Pre-materialization inspection of the frozen S3G3B industry artifact showed that the authoritative normalized industry_code_primary is not populated across the legacy CSRC_2012_GUIDE population. Using source-layout carry-forward or current-industry backfill during Stage4 materialization would create a new unaccepted inference after the Stage3 freeze. Because no Alpha training has started, V1.0 is superseded before materialization rather than silently repairing the input.

industry_evidence.builder_policy: The frozen Stage3 builder writes normalize_record() output directly; no new Stage4 cross-row inheritance or current-industry backfill is authorized.

replacement.change: INDUSTRY_IDENTITY_PIT becomes OUT_PENDING_NORMALIZATION_PLUGIN and model_visible=false. All other accepted V1 families remain unchanged.
